visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A cartoon character wearing a yellow hooded sweatshirt and brown pants sits at a dark brown table. They have a grumpy facial expression with a downturned mouth and squinted eyes, holding a small brown bottle labeled 'SOY SAUCE'. In front of them sits a white bowl filled with steamed white rice and a pair of dark chopsticks. (2) A second character, a girl with vibrant pink hair tied in two large circular buns, enters the frame from the left. She wears a white long-sleeved shirt with a black Chinese character '北' on the front and has a very stern, disapproving expression with her arms tightly crossed. (3) The yellow-hooded character tilts the soy sauce bottle over the rice bowl. A thick brown liquid pours out, coating the top of the white rice. The girl in the white shirt reacts with a sudden huff of annoyance, leaning her head back and closing her eyes in disgust before reaching out and taking the bowl away. (4) The scene shifts to a kitchen setting where the pink-haired girl turns a grey dial on a gas stove, causing a blue and orange flame to ignite under a black frying pan. She proceeds to perform a series of exaggerated cooking movements, tossing green peas, orange carrots, and yellow corn into the air and punching them with her fists as if practicing martial arts. (5) A large pink sausage appears floating in the air against a background of orange action lines. The girl leaps into the air with a kitchen knife, slicing the sausage into many small, uniform pieces with a single strike. She then holds a red packet labeled 'MSG' and tosses a pinch into the pan with a sophisticated, finger-flicking gesture. (6) The girl vigorously tosses the rice and ingredients in the pan over the open flame. She then plates the finished fried rice, adding a large yellow omelet on top. She uses a knife to slice the omelet open, revealing the steaming rice inside, and squirts red ketchup onto it in the shape of an angry face. The yellow-hooded character sits back down and begins eating the elaborate meal while the girl stands nearby holding a live white chicken.

It uses the contrast between a simple bowl of rice and a hyper-active, professional-style cooking performance to create humor and visual engagement.
